mapper.select: SELECT PUBLIC_KEY AS "publicKey" ,PRIVATE_KEY AS "privateKey" FROM T_PUSH_KEY WHERE ID = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_PUSH_KEY (ID, PUBLIC_KEY, PRIVATE_KEY) VALUES (1, #{publicKey}, #{privateKey}) ON CONFLICT (ID) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO T_PUSH_SUB (USER_ID, ENDPOINT, P256DH, AUTH, DEVICE) VALUES (#{userId}, #{endpoint}, #{p256dh}, #{auth}, #{device}) ON CONFLICT (ENDPOINT) DO UPDATE SET USER_ID = EXCLUDED.USER_ID ,P256DH = EXCLUDED.P256DH ,AUTH = EXCLUDED.AUTH ,DEVICE = EXCLUDED.DEVICE ,FAIL_COUNT = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_PUSH_SUB WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
SELECT ID AS "id" ,ENDPOINT AS "endpoint" ,P256DH AS "p256dh" ,AUTH AS "auth" FROM T_PUSH_SUB WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY ID

SELECT ID AS "id" ,DEVICE AS "device" ,RIGHT(ENDPOINT, 24) AS "tail" ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM INS_DAY) * 1000)::BIGINT AS "insAt" ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM LAST_OK_DAY) * 1000)::BIGINT AS "lastOkAt" FROM T_PUSH_SUB WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY ID DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE T_PUSH_SUB SET LAST_OK_DAY = NOW(), FAIL_COUNT = 0 WHERE ID = #{id}
UPDATE T_PUSH_SUB SET FAIL_COUNT = FAIL_COUNT + 1 WHERE ID = #{id}
